# Escala Tokens

> Desktop design-token generator. Custom engine (not Style Dictionary). Output: Escala JSON, CSS variables, W3C DTCG, Agent Skill zip, Figma plugin sync.

The source of truth for a generated system is the live token payload, not this repo's UI chrome.

## Agent entry

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Router — hard rules, where code lives, what not to invent
- [Contracts](docs/agent-native/CONTRACTS.md): Frozen HTTP, schema versions, persist, color, naming
- [Token JSON Schema](docs/agent-native/tokens.schema.json): Machine-readable `generateTokenJSON()` shape
- [Component contracts](spec/contracts/index.json): One JSON per component — API, Figma set, anatomy, every token it consumes, Storybook story
- [Get started (in-app Docs)](docs/agent-native/GET-STARTED-PLAN.md): Destinations (Figma / Code / AI), not file formats
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Current rules, repo map and sources of truth (short)
- [CLAUDE archive](docs/history/CLAUDE-archive-2026-11-16.md): Why each rule exists — search by keyword, never load whole
- [Brand context](.impeccable.md): Users and aesthetic direction

## Live access (HTTP)

- `GET https://www.escalatokens.com/docs/agent-native/tokens.schema.json` — Escala JSON Schema
- `GET https://www.escalatokens.com/api/tokens?project=<slug>` — published Escala JSON (public read)
- `POST https://www.escalatokens.com/api/tokens?project=<slug>` — publish from the configurator (same-origin + claim)

`/api/tokens` is frozen. There is no hosted MCP (deleted 2026-10-20): read the published Escala JSON above, or use the offline agent package (Export → AI).

## Code (do not invent a second copy)

- `src/lib/tokenGenerator.ts` — schema version + JSON
- `src/lib/aiContext.ts` — `agent-context/v1` envelope
- `src/lib/agentBundle/` — TokenJSON → Skill files/zip (no store)
- `src/lib/skillExport.ts` — store wrapper around agentBundle
- `src/lib/agentAccess/` — resolve, catalogue, contrast helpers (no store)
- `evals/agent-output/` — pass/fail corpus for the generated checker
- `src/lib/componentCatalogue.ts` — components, props, a11y
- `src/lib/color/apca.ts` — the only contrast math
- `../escala-figma-plugin/src/code.ts` — Figma import (authoritative component sets)
